question: On a disjoint eight-frame sequence, does deterministic Q8 remain near NATURAL32 in scene-linear temporal-error delta while retaining a substantial advantage over deterministic Q4?

design.sequenceSemantics: each cell-replicate launches one fresh Blender process and renders all frames in ascending order inside that process

analysis.referenceAtFrame: pixelwise mean of REFERENCE1024_A and REFERENCE1024_B
analysis.spatialEdgeMagnitude: RGB Euclidean central-difference gradient magnitude on the reference
analysis.spatialEdgeMaskRule: For both endpoints select exact top 25,920 pixels by magnitude descending then flattened C-row-major index ascending; use their union for the transition.
analysis.motionMagnitude: RGB Euclidean magnitude of reference_t minus reference_t-1
analysis.motionMaskRule: Select exact top 25,920 pixels by magnitude descending then flattened C-row-major index ascending.
metrics: RMSE and maximum absolute temporal error delta per transition and method replicate
mean replicate RMSE for NATURAL32, Q4 and Q8
Q4/NATURAL, Q8/NATURAL and Q8/Q4 RMSE ratios in every domain
REFERENCE1024 A/B temporal residual delta divided by NATURAL32 temporal error-delta mean
Q4 and Q8 composite A/B exactness per frame and transition
observed Blender render seconds by cell

thresholdRationale.q8ToNatural: Frozen round ceilings retain approximately 11-20 percent multiplicative headroom above the domain-specific derivation maxima.
thresholdRationale.q8ToQ4EveryTransition: 0.75 retains approximately 29 percent headroom above the derivation maximum of 0.58030.
thresholdRationale.q8ToQ4DomainMean: 0.65 retains approximately 14 percent headroom above the largest derivation domain mean of 0.57036.
thresholdRationale.q4: Q4 is measured but has no near-natural gate because the derivation itself observed a material temporal-proxy deficit.

attacksRequired: wrong spec or derivation evidence-basis hash
wrong scene, Blender or OCIO identity
changed frame interval, point set, weights, samples or threads
out-of-order, missing or hash-mismatched EXR output
non-empty work or evidence directory at start
changed reference reliability or repeatability gate
nonClaims: The dual REFERENCE1024 mean is a reference proxy, not ground truth.
A temporal-error proxy pass is not proof that flicker is invisible or that motion is cinematic.
Motion blur is disabled and this holdout covers one scene, eight frames, one Blender build and one machine.
The experiment does not establish human preference, display-dependent visibility or delivery-codec behavior.
Q4 has no formal near-natural gate; its measurements remain descriptive.
Passing does not prove the eight-point layout or equal weights are optimal.
